title: Base applies 'Azul' upgrade to mainnet to enhance decentralization
summary: Base has applied its Azul upgrade to the mainnet, The Block reported. The upgrade aims to enhance the decentralization of the Coinbase-backed Ethereum (ETH) Layer 2 network. Azul introduces a multi-proof structure that combines Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) proofs with Zero-Knowledge (ZK) proofs. This system is designed to effectively shorten withdrawal processing times when both proofs yield the same result.

title: South Korean court suspends regulator's partial business ban on Coinone
summary: A South Korean court has granted an injunction to halt a three-month partial business suspension imposed on the crypto exchange Coinone by the country's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), Yonhap News reported. The Seoul Administrative Court's decision today suspends the penalty until 30 days after a verdict is reached in the main lawsuit.Last month, the FIU imposed the suspension and a 5.2 billion won ($3.8 million) fine on Coinone. The regulator cited 90,000 alleged violations of the Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information, including failures in customer due diligence and transacting with unregistered virtual asset service providers. more:
